hotel.name: 1001 Nights - Alf Leila Wa Leila
hotel.address: few munites walking from the airport
hotel.useful_tips:
Book a room overlooking the courtyard for the evening lantern display.
The rooftop terrace is quietest in the mornings; the restaurant gets busy after 20:00.
Ask the front desk about the shuttle to the old market — free and easy to miss.
Friday brunch is excellent value and popular with locals.
If you have an early flight, request a packed breakfast the night before.
hotel.house_rules:
• Check-in: 15:00 – 23:00
• Check-out: 12:00 (late check-out available on request)
• No smoking in rooms; designated smoking areas only
• Pets are not permitted
• Quiet hours: 23:00 – 07:00
• Children under 12 stay free when sharing with two adults
• Outside food and beverages not permitted in restaurant areas
hotel.check_in_details:
Check-in from 15:00. Early check-in is subject to availability — contact the hotel the day before.

You will need: passport (foreign nationals), booking reference, and a credit card for incidentals.

Airport transfers are available 24/7. Book at least 48 hours in advance.

Luggage storage is complimentary for early arrivals and late departures.
hotel.cancellation_policy:
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
50% refundable between 48 and 24 hours before check-in.
Non-refundable within 24 hours of check-in.

No-shows are charged the full first-night rate plus taxes. Refunds are processed within 7–10 business days.
hotel.neighborhood_info: Located in a quiet residential pocket just minutes from the main promenade, the hotel offers easy access to local restaurants, shops, and the beach. A small supermarket and pharmacy are directly across the street. The airport is a short 15-minute drive away.
